scope: Read-only audit of simulated V4 tactile analog/acquisition coverage against current V4 manifest.
verdict: partial_coverage; no V4 hardware validation claim

coverage.covered: Manifest-checked 20 site topology; one-cell SPICE with 531 pF PVDF, 50/150/300/1000 pF cable sweeps, 100 kOhm input, BAV199 clamps, 22 MOhm/470 pF feedback, two Sallen-Key stages, 20-2000 Hz cases and passive tolerance sweep. V4 electrical/components.json retains the same value/MPN topology and records the V3 canonical source hash.
coverage.gap: The saved result is dated V3 and has no V4-run identity. It does not electrically simulate all 20 channels simultaneously, shared reference loading, channel-to-channel coupling, laminate force response, noise, or temperature corners.

coverage.covered: V4 labels now agree with the actual MPN/value fields: RV0805FR-0722ML/22Meg and GRM1885C1H471JA01D/470p, matching the saved decks.
coverage.gap: Historical V3 evidence remains the provenance; a V4-named netlist rerun and hash is still absent.

coverage.covered: Seven complete RC-proxy cases: dynamic 0.1↔2.5 V, pressure 0↔2.5 V with 10 kOhm source, 1 kOhm mux resistance, 80/40 pF mux nodes, doubled-capacitance sensitivity; settling under 11 us in the proxy.
coverage.gap: No measured Velostat/Linqstat resistance or pressure-range sweep, nonlinear resistance, sensor hysteresis, adjacent-channel crosstalk, 20-pressure scan, or 50 Hz analog excitation schedule.

coverage.covered: Positive/negative charge cases through ±500 pC and ±50 nC protected cases are represented; 1 fF regularized reruns are separately identified.
coverage.gap: Native negative -1 pC and -250 pC cases abort; protected negative -250 pC and -50 nC also abort. No V4 rail-clipping, overload-recovery, or physical PVDF overstress test exists.

coverage.area: ADC driver, reference and differential input
coverage.covered: OPA4323/OPA320 vendor models with 22 Ohm isolation, 1 nF bucket, 200 Ohm/31 pF ADC-equivalent load; positive single-ended RC settling cases. REF3330 load/headroom arithmetic exists in the inherited power validation.
coverage.gap: The transient deck uses ideal 3.3 V supply and single-ended 0.1/2.5 V source. It does not model V4 REF3330 dynamic impedance/ESR, 1.8 V AVDD, 3.3 V DVIO, VMID1V25 negative driver, differential common-mode, reference kickback, CNV/SCK switched SAR behavior, or rail decoupling/impedance.

coverage.covered: Native firmware fixture exercises 520 synthetic 4 kHz ADC samples on one channel and reports pressure scheduling; host checks preserve counts/features.
coverage.gap: This is firmware/data-path evidence, not a 20-channel analog simulation. No analog deck drives 20 PVDF channels concurrently or interleaves 20 pressure channels at 50 Hz under mux/reference load.

coverage.covered: PVDF single-channel cable values 50/150/300/1000 pF; mux proxy capacitance 80/40 pF and doubled sensitivity.
coverage.gap: No routed/harness extraction, per-branch cable variation, shared-return coupling, switch charge injection, extraction/settling across consecutive channels, or crosstalk metric.

coverage.covered: V4 pin/net mapping exists; camera translator static voltage margins and I2C sink/rise arithmetic are checked.
coverage.gap: No voltage/timing simulation for tactile SN74AHC595 mux-address controls, CD74HC4067 S0-S3/COM behavior, ADC CNV/SCK/SDO at 1.8/3.3 V domains, or translator dynamic loading. Camera checks explicitly state dynamic waveforms still require target integration.

coverage.covered: Inherited V3.3 power validation covers the canonical topology: REF3330 3.0 V load/headroom arithmetic, VEXC dual-loop 47 Ohm/10 kOhm/100 nF with 0.8/1/1.2/2 uF bulk cases and 5 mA load-step, and VMID driving all 20 passive filter branches with 0.1/1/10 nF direct-parasitic cases. V4 retains the same VEXC/VMID component topology and 1 uF VEXC reservoir.
coverage.gap: Those decks use an ideal 3.3 V supply and typical 25 C vendor model. They do not model the V4 3.416 V main rail, REF3330 transient/ESR, V4 rail gates and decoupling impedance, startup/shutdown sequencing, or the coupled ADC/reference/mux load. They are inherited topology evidence, not a V4 assembled-board result.

required_followups: Generate one V4-declared coupled transient deck from electrical/components.json values and hash the generated netlist against the V4 manifest.
Model REF3330, U_VMID excitation/midpoint loops, 1.8 V ADC AVDD, 3.3 V DVIO, both ADC inputs and actual rail decoupling/impedance.
Run 20-channel sequential and concurrent PVDF/pressure cases with measured or bounded sensor resistance/capacitance and a crosstalk metric.
Run negative overload/recovery cases to completion without numerical regularization being presented as hardware proof.
Capture logic-analyzer/oscilloscope evidence for 250 us scan deadlines, 50 Hz pressure schedule, CNV/SCK/SDO, mux address controls and analog rails.

Run that coupled deck at 3.416 V main rail: REF3330/reference reservoir, VEXC 1 uF plus 20×10 kOhm pressure load, VMID with all 20 filter branches, one mux-bank transition, one PVDF pulse and one pressure step during the 250 us scan; record rail ripple, VEXC/VMID settling, ADC differential settling and selected-channel crosstalk.
claim_boundary: The inherited evidence supports the V3-derived PVDF, mux proxy, REF3330 arithmetic, VEXC dual-loop and all-20 passive VMID topology. It does not establish V4 3.416 V coupled-board electrical behavior, material force calibration, noise, crosstalk, or sustained 20-channel hardware acquisition.
